name: kinvent-companion-cli-sample
description: Developer sample, not for clinical use: a Node.js command-line program that records raw samples from Kinvent sensors through the Kinvent Companion app, using @kinvent/companion-sdk.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.testing.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:testing && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const d='dist-testing/testing/tests';if(!fs.existsSync(d)||!fs.readdirSync(d).some((f)=>f.endsWith('.test.js'))){console.error('No compiled tests in '+d+'. Run: npm run build:testing');process.exit(1)}" && node --test "dist-testing/testing/tests/*.test.js"
